Intro: And what exactly are you looking at, punk? I'm here for food. Correct me if I'm wrong, but I thought that's what these joints were for.
Now you listen to me. I'm hungry, and I ain't exactly in a waiting mood right now.
So I want your finest [DISH]. Make it snappy, and I'll be outta here 'fore you know it.
Success: Alright, not bad! But don't go gettin' a big head, or you'll have to answer to me!
Fail: So what, you're servin' people garbage these days? That's low! You ain't worth my time.
Reject: Eh, what's that? Think I'm spoiled? Now THAT'S a good one! You got guts, pal, I'll give ya that.
